chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sulaymān narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to travel on Thursday.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Jaʿfar; the Imam from whom the hadith is reported
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah; the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the report
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ: on Thursday; the specific day mentioned for travel
key_terms.يُسَافِرُ: he would travel; refers to setting out on a journey

ai.seo_question: On which day did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to travel?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the timing of travel. It indicates that Thursday was among the days on which he would set out on a journey, reflecting a transmitted sunnah concerning recommended travel times.
